items.name: spec_compliance
items.note: All 9 user items implemented (board lanes flex, list single scroller+sticky th, tablet viewer on demand, keyboard viewport fit, table CSS, maximize removed in compact, description inline, tree sizing, triage meta row); spec.md FR-01.38 gained (G)-(J).

items.name: error_handling
items.note: Client-only layout work; the hook no-ops without visualViewport/matchMedia.

items.name: security_basics
items.note: No new inputs, routes or trust boundaries; description still rendered as an escaped text node.

items.name: test_quality
items.note: Unit: tablet viewer shell (4), keyboard fit pure fn + hook (7), lane class contract, inline description. Real-browser spec tablet-mobile-polish.spec.ts (7) measures geometry; mobile-work-mode spec updated.

items.name: performance_basics
items.note: Hook handlers are O(1) attribute writes on vv resize/scroll/focus events; cleaned up on unmount.

items.name: naming_structure
items.note: ViewerToggle, useKeyboardViewportFit and keyboard-fit.css follow existing grouping; all files under 300 lines.

items.name: affected_boundaries
items.note: No serialized format touched; tablet viewer state is transient React state, desktop rightCollapsed localStorage untouched (unit-proved).

items.name: test_hygiene_probe
items.note: No skips or weakened assertions; two obsolete assertions (maximize in compact, description popover) were rewritten to the new contract.
